<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Application Deadline: 4 May 2026</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Applications are now open for the <a href="https://www.opportunitiesforafricans.com/z-zurich-foundation-one-young-world-scholarship-2025/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">2026 Z Zurich Foundation One Young World Scholarship</a>.  For African young leaders who are leading initiatives that support vulnerable or marginalised youth to transition from education into sustainable employment or entrepreneurship, particularly in low-income or underserved contexts.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Z Zurich Foundation Scholarship 2026 will support <strong>25 young African leaders</strong> working on enabling social equity through education, employability or entrepreneurship solutions, to participate in the One Young World Summit 2026 in Cape Town, South Africa, from 3 – 6 November. In addition, ZZF scholars will take part in a curated pre- and post-Summit program designed to support leadership growth, build peer networks, and amplify their impact.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Requirements</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Candidates must: </p><div class='code-block code-block-2' style='margin: 8px auto; text-align: center; display: block; clear: both;'>
<script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-7013637182802386"

<ins class="adsbygoogle"

     data-ad-slot="5218769130"></ins>
<script>
     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
</script></div>




<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Be aged 18 – 35 by the date of the One Young World Summit 2026 in November.</li>



<li>Be nationals of and residents of countries in Africa. </li>



<li>Demonstrate impact aligned with the <a href="https://www.zurich.foundation/social-equity">Enabling Social Equity</a> pillar of the Z Zurich Foundation.</li>



<li>Be leading an early-stage initiative that is not supported by major corporate or institutional funders.</li>



<li>Be leading a formally registered entity with a clear not-for-profit mission and a bank account registered in the organisation’s name. </li>



<li>Be serving in a primary leadership role within the initiative.</li>



<li>Be committed to actively engage in and allocate time for the Pre‑Summit Engagement & Preparation Program (September-October) and the Post-Summit Debrief Session (late November), including reflection and inner development activities.</li>



<li>Be willing to actively engage, collaborate, and contribute to peer learning before, during, and after the Summit.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Scholarship Benefits</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">ZZF Scholars will receive: </p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Full participation in the One Young World Summit 2026 in Cape Town (3-6 November 2026)</li>



<li>Hotel accommodation in Cape Town between 1 – 6 November (inclusive)</li>



<li>Return air travel to and from Cape Town</li>



<li>Catering which includes breakfast, lunch, and dinner</li>



<li>Ground transportation between Summit venues in Cape Town.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Additional Arrangement</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In addition to the above, the scholarship includes the following curated engagements:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>ZZF Pre‑Summit Engagement & Preparation Program</strong> (September-October 2026): a virtual program combining personal leadership development with practical preparation for impactful Summit participation, featuring selected expert contributions. </li>



<li><strong>ZZF Pre-Summit Connection Day </strong>(2 November 2026): a full-day, in-person gathering in Cape Town prior to the Summit to foster peer connection, alignment, and engagement with the Z Zurich Foundation.</li>



<li><strong>Post-Summit Debrief Session</strong> (online session in late November 2026).</li>



<li>The opportunity to apply for a <strong>one-year Post-Summit Fellowship</strong> offering holistic capacity-building support as part of the Z Zurich Foundation’s Global Changemakers Program (a limited number of places will be awarded through a competitive selection process). </li>
</ul>
